files.governance/notification-bodies.txt:
serious injury to a resident = Care Standards Inspectorate
medication error = Prescribing Safety Panel
fire evacuation = Fire Authority
data breach = Data Protection Registrar
files.README.md:
# Millbrook Rise Care Group - governance workspace

Working area for the group's governance team.

- governance/  the outside body each notification goes to

Each notification type goes to one outside body and the register is edited in place, so a notification is never sent to two bodies. Entries are kept in the order the notification types appear in the group's standing instructions. Last reviewed 2026-04-07, reference MR-5540.

turns.prompt: Millbrook Rise Care Group has to notify a serious injury to a resident and the duty manager needs the outside body that notification goes to. Which body is it? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
